verified_scope_note: Covers personal, non-commercial travel from the United States to Panama for dogs and cats. USDA APHIS endorsement of the certificate, its consular or apostille legalization, and the MIDA and MINSA documentation check and inspection on arrival at Tocumen are decided outside Petra.

caveats.text: Panama's MIDA and MINSA officers perform the documentation check and veterinary inspection when you arrive at Tocumen International Airport (PTY); Petra cannot pre-clear this step.

manual_checklist.title: Email MINSA the Home Quarantine Request / Solicitud de Ingreso (cam@minsa.gob.pa)
manual_checklist.detail: Sent 3 to 5 business days before arrival to cam@minsa.gob.pa (MINSA Departamento de Control de Zoonosis). Mandatory: include the arrival flight/date/time, a scanned copy of the APHIS-endorsed health certificate, and the vaccination record (cartilla de vacunación). Without it the pet may be held at Tocumen until MINSA processes it.

manual_checklist.title: Internal + external parasite treatment before shipment
manual_checklist.detail: A licensed vet administers and records internal and external antiparasitic treatment before export, declared on the certificate. Petra has no separate evidence model for this treatment; confirm it from the certificate before travel.

manual_checklist.title: Pet at least 4 months old; first rabies dose ≥30 days before arrival
manual_checklist.detail: Panama requires rabies vaccination from 3 months of age with at least 30 days elapsed since the FIRST dose, so animals under about 4 months of age are not allowed into the country. The engine does not model age or first-vs-booster dose, so confirm the age and first-dose timing before travel.

manual_checklist.title: Legalize the APHIS-endorsed certificate (consular stamp or apostille, within 30 days)
manual_checklist.detail: After APHIS endorsement, the certificate is legalized for Panama EITHER by a Panamanian consulate stamp/signature OR by apostille (Cancillería, or the US Department of State Office of Authentications where no Panamanian consulate serves your state), within 30 days of issuance. This legalization is captured as the certificate's authentication step in Petra's external-document check; carry the original legalized certificate.

manual_checklist.title: Plan the airline-validity window
manual_checklist.detail: Airlines and Panamanian authorities expect the APHIS endorsement and the 30-day legalization window to still be valid on the day of travel. Coordinate the endorsement, legalization and travel date so the certificate isn't too fresh OR too stale.

manual_checklist.title: On-arrival processing fees
manual_checklist.detail: MIDA and MINSA charge processing and veterinary-inspection fees per animal at Tocumen, typically payable in cash; a strict home quarantine, if required, carries an additional charge. Amounts change: confirm the current fees before travel and bring cash.

manual_checklist.title: Home quarantine on arrival if required
manual_checklist.detail: MINSA may impose a home quarantine at the owner's Panama residence; duration and any strict-quarantine charge are set per-arrival. Plan accommodation accordingly: a Panama address is generally required for the Solicitud de Ingreso.
